Its own account

Its bet
Three places that never move — today, the rooms, the bookings — with what is free now always in the middle, let her answer a walk-in without looking for where to go.
Deliberately bad at
A week ahead is out of reach: every place shows today, and a booking for another day is taken on paper.
Absent on purpose
  • Any day but today
  • The practitioners' own schedules
  • A floor plan she can click
In the hardest state
With every room busy, the middle of Today names the room that frees up soonest and when, and Book a walk-in books that time.
